tasks.gr11-xho-listening-t3: Topic: Debate, prepared speech, seminar discussion, and oral response to issues. Cover debate structure (proposition, opposition, rebuttal), techniques for sustaining an argument orally, seminar discussion protocols and academic register, and responding thoughtfully to literary and civic topics. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to identify debate roles, construct a counter-argument, use academic register correctly, and structure an oral response to a social issue.
tasks.gr11-xho-reading-t3: Topic: Drama, poetry, short stories, critical reading, and contextual analysis. Cover drama elements (conflict, climax, stage directions), poetry figures of speech and contextual meaning, narrative techniques in short stories, and identifying author assumptions and purpose in critical reading. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to analyse conflict in drama, interpret figures of speech, identify narrative point of view, and evaluate an author's assumptions with evidence.
tasks.gr11-xho-writing-t3: Topic: Argumentative and discursive essay, formal letter, article, and project presentation. Cover argumentative essay structure (thesis, evidence, counter-argument, conclusion), the difference between argumentative and discursive approaches, formal letter and article conventions, and structuring an academic project presentation. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to identify thesis statements, distinguish argumentative from discursive writing, apply formal letter format, and organise a project presentation.
tasks.gr11-xho-language-t3: Topic: Complex sentences, style, punctuation, editing, and vocabulary refinement. Cover main and subordinate clauses, formal vs informal style choices, punctuation marks (commas, colons, semicolons), editing for error correction and clarity, and choosing precise vocabulary. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to identify clause types, choose appropriate style, correctly punctuate complex sentences, edit errors, and select synonyms for precision.
